newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai phone lines to grow four/sixfold by 2020.
newsitem.headline: Thai phone lines to grow four/sixfold by 2020.

text.p: The Thai telecommuications industry will grow rapidly over the next couple of decades with the number of telephone lines increasing by four to six times, a senior Thai official said on Thursday.

Deputy Minister of Transport and Communications Direk Charoenphol told an industry conference he expected there would be 7.5 million telephone lines in Thailand by the end of 1998 for an estimated population of 60.6 million.

Urging foreign telecommunications companies to invest in Thailand, Direk said the number of phone lines would grow to between 8.9 and 10.2 million by 2001, assuming the country's economic growth ranged between six and eight per cent a year.
Direk said he expected to have 27 million to 44 million telephone lines by 2020 serving a population of 75.4 million, assuming the same economic growth figures.
"These are real prospects. Whether it can happen or not depends on economic factors," Direk said.
